components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action in a task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:50px; padding:0 24px; border:0; border-radius:16px; background:#C8A86B; color:#0B0B0B; font:600 14px Manrope, sans-serif; transition:opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity:.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity:.78; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F7F4EE; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A clear alternative without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height:50px; padding:0 24px; border:1px solid #4B402B; border-radius:16px; background:#0B0B0B; color:#C8A86B; font:600 14px Manrope, sans-serif; transition:background 150ms cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#2B251A; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity:.78; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C8A86B; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A destructive action that stays visually subordinate until chosen.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height:50px; padding:0 24px; border:1px solid #EB5757; border-radius:16px; background:#0B0B0B; color:#EB5757; font:600 14px Manrope, sans-serif; transition:background 150ms cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:#351010; } .ds-btn-danger:active { opacity:.78; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #EB5757; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A substantial, clearly editable private-data control.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#F7F4EE; font:600 13px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height:50px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #2B2B29; border-radius:16px; background:#20201F; color:#F7F4EE; font:500 16px Manrope, sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#8C9099; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#4B402B; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#C8A86B; outline:none; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: One bounded task on the continuous charcoal canvas.
components.html:
YOUR JOURNEY / 01

One place for measurable progress.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:24px; border:1px solid #2B2B29; border-radius:24px; background:#151515; color:#F7F4EE; } .ds-card-label { color:#C8A86B; font:600 10px Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing:1.6px; } .ds-card h3 { margin:12px 0 0; font:600 24px/30px 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.7px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid #4B402B; border-radius:999px; background:#2B251A; color:#C8A86B; font:600 10px Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing:1.4px; } .ds-status i { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:999px; background:#6FCF97; } .ds-status:hover { border-color:#C8A86B; } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C8A86B; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: BONYAN is used in private, high-attention moments: signing in, reviewing body composition, logging training, and generating an identity-adjacent Avatar. The dark charcoal environment suits focused use on a personal device, while rare bronze cues make the next trusted action unmistakable. The Human Foundry combines measurement precision with deliberate progress. It should feel sculptural without becoming ornamental, premium without becoming luxurious, and technical without resembling a clinical dashboard. Familiar mobile affordances must disappear into the task. The interface rejects fitness neon, sterile medical white, gamified noise, and generic AI-assistant decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained charcoal and graphite surfaces with one measured bronze accent.
Strong editorial identity in headings, calm operational clarity everywhere else.
Large, touchable controls with explicit privacy and system-state language.
Tonal layering and quiet borders instead of decorative shadows.
Consistent task flows that preserve BONYAN's existing visual and product baseline.

rules.name: The Bronze Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Bronze marks the next meaningful action, current selection, or measured progress. If everything is bronze, nothing is actionable.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Mint means success and coral means error or danger. Neither color is allowed as decoration.

rules.name: The One Display Voice Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk is reserved for identity, hierarchy, and numeric landmarks. Buttons, inputs, explanatory copy, and operational labels always use Manrope.

rules.name: The Tracked Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracking belongs only to short labels. Never apply it to sentences, errors, button copy, or user data.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Raise a surface by changing its tone and boundary, never by adding a dark, tight, decorative shadow.

rules.name: The No Nested Cards Rule
rules.body: A card owns one bounded task. Group content inside it with spacing and dividers, not another card.

dos: Do use Charcoal Ground as the continuous canvas and preserve the ordered tonal surface hierarchy.
Do reserve Measured Bronze for primary actions, selection, progress, and compact labels.
Do use the 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, and 48px spacing scale for deliberate mobile rhythm.
Do keep controls at least 50px high and expose disabled, loading, error, and accessibility states.
Do state privacy, ownership, and irreversible consequences in plain language near the action.
Do preserve the current prototype and implemented BONYAN screens as the visual source of truth.
donts: Don't redesign BONYAN into fitness neon, sterile medical white, a gamified dashboard, or a generic AI-assistant interface.
Don't use bronze as decoration or apply full-saturation color to inactive states.
Don't add gradients, gradient text, glassmorphism, decorative blur, or ornamental glow.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders, identical card grids, or cards nested inside cards.
Don't add shadows to simulate depth when the tonal surface hierarchy already communicates it.
Don't use Space Grotesk for body copy, form labels, buttons, or long operational text.
Don't invent navigation, custom form controls, or modal flows when a standard mobile affordance already solves the task.
Don't add decorative motion. Feedback transitions stay between 150 and 250ms and communicate state.
